name: random-seating-web
description: Web quay random chỗ ngồi điều khiển bằng Telegram bot

scripts.build: javascript-obfuscator client/app.js --output public/app.js --compact true --control-flow-flattening true --control-flow-flattening-threshold 0.7 --dead-code-injection true --dead-code-injection-threshold 0.3 --string-array true --string-array-encoding base64 --string-array-threshold 1 --split-strings true --split-strings-chunk-length 6 --self-defending true --rename-globals true --identifier-names-generator hexadecimal --disable-console-output false
